integrity: The algebraic proof is for all positive integer founder pairs and all stated probabilities; exact rational enumeration through twelve founder pairs is supplementary. Literature originality remains open to independent literature verification; there is no independent audit.
scientific_limitations: The model optimizes a one-step mate-availability and independent binary-suitability event; it does not describe later reproduction, Allee demographic growth, correlated environmental failures, or actual long-term establishment. The general odd-budget policy is an exact two-value sign comparison, without an asserted single threshold. Certain potentially relevant original papers could not be inspected in full, leaving literature-coverage risk.
title: An all-or-nearly-even release theorem for two-site mate-limited establishment
